# Lava Lamp (`lavaLamp`)

Glossy wax rising and falling through warm, backlit liquid.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: heavy (~6.4 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Lava Lamp, Ultraviolet Lamp

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 0.6 |
| `blobs` | Blobs | slider | 3 … 10 (step 1) | 7 |
| `size` | Size | slider | 0.5 … 1.6 | 1 |
| `gloss` | Gloss | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.7 |
| `heat` | Lamp Glow | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `glass` | Glass | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |

| `colorB` | Wax | {"r":1,"g":0.36,"b":0.16} |
